ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.23.05 - SECURITY: Improv-over-BLE now requires an authorizer that is only active while the unit has never completed onboarding. Previously (authorizer: none) any provisioned unit that lost its router for 90s restarted Improv already AUTHORIZED, letting anyone in BLE range re-provision it onto another network; a failed attempt also wiped the saved credentials via clear_sta(). Factory reset re-opens BLE provisioning. Also tiers 36 installer-set-once entities (output mode, idle state, cycle/warning/travel times, trigger colour, per-door reporting, logging level, trigger OTA) as disabled_by_default, cutting Home Assistant's first-open list from 70 to 34. Tiered entities remain fully readable and writable over the REST/SSE API, so the Innovo Android app is unaffected; in Home Assistant they appear under '+N entities not shown' and can be enabled individually.
